content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-149. - Decision of council final.
content.summary:
The action and decision of the council proceeding hereunder as to all matters passed
               upon by the council in relation to any action, matter or thing provided herein shall
               be final and conclusive in the absence of fraud.
(Code 1981, § 27-149; Ord. No. 551, § 90, 5-14-1964…
